rotationSign: CSS rotate(); positive = clockwise on screen

nibble.howTo: Rotate #neck +101 (swings the neck forward and down from the chest) and #head -58 (nested in #neck, keeps the face pointing down and forward). The mouth then touches the ground line (y 426) at about x 488, in front of the front hooves. Ease both from 0 together; chew with small #head wobbles of +-4 around -58.

parts.description: Far hind leg (darker); pivot at the hip, top hidden under the body (+ back, - forward).
Far front leg (darker); pivot at the shoulder (+ back, - forward).
Short upturned tail; pivot at the root (+ tips forward over the rump, - tips back/down).
Near hind leg; pivot at the hip (+ back, - forward).
Near front leg; pivot at the shoulder (+ back, - forward).

Neck (contains 'head'); pivot low in the chest, base hidden behind the body. + swings the neck forward and down (to graze), - raises it. Above about +60 also turn the head negative or the face goes into the ground (nibble = neck +101, head -58).

Head with horns, ear, eye, beard; nested inside 'neck', pivot at the poll (top of the neck). + tips the nose down, - lifts it. On its own keep it within -25..+25; the big negative values are only for the nibble (paired with neck > +60).
Torso; covers the leg tops and the neck base. Pivot near the centre for a gentle sway.
